title: A Tight Broad-line Width–Luminosity Relation in Little Red Dots and Its Consequence for Virial Black Hole Masses: data and code

creators.name: Zhao, Xinmiao
creators.affiliation: Department of Astronomy, School of Physics, Peking University, Beijing 100871, People's Republic of China

description:
Per-source broad Hα line measurements (six measures of width, with covariances) for 29 little red dots and 15 other broad-line sources refitted from public JWST/NIRSpec grating spectra, repeat-spectrum error-floor calibrations, SDSS DR7 quasars refitted with the same procedure, sample selection records, regression and injection-recovery simulation code, scripts generating every number, table, and figure of the accompanying paper, and its AASTeX v7.0.1 manuscript source.

Code is released under the MIT license; measurements, tables, figures, and documentation under CC BY 4.0. Third-party material keeps its own terms (see ATTRIBUTION.md).
